CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."users" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL, -- Real accounts only.
    "email" text,
    "role" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "deleted_at" timestamp with time zone -- Real users have deleted_at IS NULL.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 2. Real user: users.deleted_at IS NULL and belongs to real account (is_test = false AND deleted_at IS NULL).
-- 10. Active user: real user with >= 1 event in events where occurred_at is in period.

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."accounts" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "name" text NOT NULL,
    "plan" text, -- DEPRECATED signup plan. NEVER use for reporting; use plan_tier instead.
    "plan_tier" text, -- Current plan tier: 'starter', 'pro', 'enterprise'. Always use for reporting.
    "is_test" boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Test account flag. Real accounts have is_test = false.
    "country" text,
    "currency" text,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, -- Half-open windows: >= start AND < next_period_start.
    "deleted_at" timestamp with time zone -- Real accounts have deleted_at IS NULL.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 1. Real account: is_test = false AND deleted_at IS NULL. Never count test or deleted accounts.
-- 3. Current plan: accounts.plan_tier (never plan).
-- 11. Paying customer in period: real account with >= 1 paid invoice (status = 'paid') with paid_at in period.
-- 12. ARPA: Net revenue in period / paying customers in period.
-- 13. Churned account: real account with >= 1 churn subscription canceled on or before date.
-- 14. Date windows: half-open (>= start AND < next_period_start). Never use BETWEEN with end date.

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."subscriptions" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL, -- Real accounts only (is_test = false AND deleted_at IS NULL).
    "plan_tier" text NOT NULL, -- Plan tier: 'starter', 'pro', 'enterprise'.
    "status" text NOT NULL, -- 'active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled'. Only 'active' is active subscription.
    "started_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "trial_ends_at" timestamp with time zone,
    "canceled_at" timestamp with time zone, -- Churn uses canceled_at >= start AND canceled_at < next_period_start.
    "cancel_reason" text -- 'voluntary', 'payment_failed', 'upgrade'. Churn only includes voluntary and payment_failed. upgrade is NOT churn.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 8. Active subscription: status = 'active' on real account. trialing and past_due are not active.
-- 9. Churn: status = 'canceled' AND cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed') with canceled_at in period on real account.

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."invoices" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "subscription_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL, -- Real accounts only: accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL.
    "amount_cents" integer NOT NULL, -- USD: amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit. Always divide as numeric.
    "currency" text NOT NULL, -- Join to fx_rates.currency for USD conversion.
    "status" text NOT NULL, -- Status: 'paid', 'open', 'failed', 'void'. Paid invoices have status = 'paid'.
    "issued_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    "paid_at" timestamp with time zone -- Filter on paid_at >= start AND paid_at < next_period_start.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 4. Money: amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit.
-- 5. Gross revenue: paid invoices (status = 'paid') on real accounts in USD with paid_at in period.
-- 7. Net revenue = Gross revenue minus Refunds (compute gross and refunds as two separate subqueries, then subtract).

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."refunds" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "invoice_id" integer NOT NULL, -- Join to invoices.id.
    "amount_cents" integer NOT NULL, -- USD: refunds.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit using invoice currency.
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL -- Filter on created_at >= start AND created_at < next_period_start.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 6. Refunds for period: refunds with created_at in period on real accounts in USD.
-- 7. Net revenue: compute gross on paid_at and refunds on created_at as two separate subqueries, then subtract.

CREATE TABLE "appdb"."public"."events" (
    "id" integer NOT NULL,
    "account_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "user_id" integer NOT NULL,
    "event_type" text NOT NULL,
    "occurred_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL -- Filter on occurred_at >= start AND occurred_at < next_period_start.
);
-- Business Rules:
-- 10. Active user in period: real user with >= 1 event in period (occurred_at >= start AND occurred_at < next_period_start).
CREATE VIEW "appdb"."public"."real_accounts" AS SELECT * FROM "appdb"."public"."accounts" WHERE "is_test" = false AND "deleted_at" IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW "appdb"."public"."real_users" AS SELECT u.* FROM "appdb"."public"."users" u JOIN "appdb"."public"."accounts" a ON u."account_id" = a."id" WHERE u."deleted_at" IS NULL AND a."is_test" = false AND a."deleted_at" IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW "appdb"."public"."paid_invoices" AS SELECT i.*, i."amount_cents"::numeric / 100 * fx."usd_per_unit" AS "amount_usd" FROM "appdb"."public"."invoices" i JOIN "appdb"."public"."accounts" a ON i."account_id" = a."id" JOIN "appdb"."public"."fx_rates" fx ON i."currency" = fx."currency" WHERE i."status" = 'paid' AND a."is_test" = false AND a."deleted_at" IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW "appdb"."public"."active_subscriptions" AS SELECT s.* FROM "appdb"."public"."subscriptions" s JOIN "appdb"."public"."accounts" a ON s."account_id" = a."id" WHERE s."status" = 'active' AND a."is_test" = false AND a."deleted_at" IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW "appdb"."public"."churn_subscriptions" AS SELECT s.* FROM "appdb"."public"."subscriptions" s JOIN "appdb"."public"."accounts" a ON s."account_id" = a."id" WHERE s."status" = 'canceled' AND s."cancel_reason" IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed') AND a."is_test" = false AND a."deleted_at" IS NULL;
